issues.message: Browse projects lists projects that can grow but has no search or filters. Fix: Give F16 search or filters for the growing projects list (e.g. search by name/client) with fields, or add an assumption that justifies why none is needed.

Designer account skip uses 'no screen in MVP' which is 'Not needed for the MVP' and holds no valid reason. Fix: Add an account flow for the designer to see and change their email/password, or replace the skip with a reason grounded in the idea or scope ruling it out.

Availability is used to generate Slots but is never created by a flow and no assumption says where it comes from. Fix: Add an assumption that weekly Availability is pre-created at sign-up (empty or default) and managed only in F25, or add a create flow for it.

All Availability fields are required, so empty availability cannot be saved, contradicting A11 and the rule that without hours no slots are offered. Fix: Make Days (FD19), From time (FD20) and To time (FD21) required false so the designer can keep weekly Availability empty with no days/hours and offer no slots per A11.
